svg.title: Three Core People, Five at Scale
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-core-and-scaled-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Three Core People, Five at Scale; subtitle: Core 1 FT + 2 C becomes 2 FT + 3 C without counting client counsel; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT denotes a full-time seat; C denotes a contractor seat, not a full-time equivalent. Numeric value is one person per seat. The first three seats form the core pod; the final two activate only in the Scaled scenario. Client counsel is an external relationship, not an uncounted pod employee.; caption: Core staffing supports the $95,000 Conservative and $487,500 Base revenue scenarios. Five-person staffing supports the $880,000 Scaled scenario. Access follows assigned matters rather than seniority; client counsel retains filing and legal-strategy responsibility.; stages: label: Core Owner Operator; value: Core seat 1; one full-time operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own client acquisition, engagement scope, billing, delivery acceptance, and cash reserves. Separate service invoices from contingent-award tracking and escalate legal questions to retained counsel.; label: Core Data Engineer; value: Core seat 2; one contracted engineer; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Build lawful ingestion, identifier resolution, versioned transformations, hashing, and reproducible anomaly rankings. Maintain source-to-exhibit lineage and restrict access to assigned client matters.; label: Core Forensic Analyst; value: Core seat 3; one contracted analyst; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Corroborate anomalies, maintain claim ledgers, test benign explanations, and prepare evidence indexes. Track conflicting facts rather than excluding records that weaken the working hypothesis.; label: Scaled Delivery Lead; value: Scaled seat 4; second full-time operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Coordinate parallel engagements, document acceptance criteria, monitor service capacity, and audit source lineage. Activate only when contracted service revenue supports recurring delivery commitments.; label: Scaled Specialist Analyst; value: Scaled seat 5; third contracted specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add healthcare coding, securities, customs, or tax expertise against defined paid scopes. Limit specialist access to relevant records and record technical assumptions in each delivered exhibit.
